question: Who was the brand ambassador of World Wildlife Fund India’s Environment Education Programme as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Viswanathan Anand.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Five-time world chess champion Viswanathan Anand** has joined WWF(World Wide Fund) India as its ambassador for the environmental education programme.
 
• WWF India is celebrating its **50 years of conservation in India**.
 
• WWF India's environmental education programme is as old as the organisation itself, starting way back in **1976 with the Nature Clubs of India **(NCI) initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Viswanathan Anand was born on December 11, 1969, in Madras.
 
• He was an Indian chess master who won the FIDE (international chess federation) world championship in 2000, 2007, 2008, 2010, and 2012.
 
• Anand learned chess from his mother at the age of 6 years old.
 
• At the age of 14, Anand had won the Indian National Sub-Junior Championship with a perfect score of nine wins in nine games.
 
• At the time he was 17 years old, he became the first Asian to win a world chess title when he won the 1987 FIDE World Junior Championship.
 
• He was the first Indian to be conferred with the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in the year 1991/1992.
